Telangana Leaders Mourn Death of Former MLA Kommidi Narasimha Reddy

Former Telangana MLA Kommidi Narasimha Reddy has passed away. Chief Minister Revanth Reddy and former Chief Minister KCR have expressed their condolences for his demise. The news highlights the passing of a political figure and the tributes from prominent leaders in the state.
